name: go-ignored-error
description: The canonical Go ignored-error idiom (`f, _ := os.Open(path)`) plus a panic inside a guard. Both were SILENT until 2026-09-04: `ignored-error` matched only `_, _ =` (both values discarded, at line start), which is the rarest form, and `panic-in-lib` was line-anchored so it never saw `if err != nil { panic(err) }`. The module claimed 'ignored errors, panics, goroutine hygiene' and detected almost none of it. Found by planting what the description promised rather than by reading the patterns, which looked plausible.
